checked.point: eating potassium saturates your cells and lowers your resting voltage, so you are harder to trigger
checked.found: the brain keeps the potassium around its neurons within tight limits whatever the blood does (Hladky and Barrand 2016), and where more potassium does reach excitable cells it moves them toward firing (Campese and Adenuga 2016)
